content:
I found a short, two-minute extract from an Russian documentary about Russian Plasma Weapons. I found it on Rutube, the Russian version of YouTube, and it seems to be from the 1990s. #ufotwitter #UFOs #uapX 

The narrator speaks of how the Soviets discovered geophysical and plasma weapons through numerous experiments.    

He said they could put Plasma Aerodynamic on their aircrafts which then can get over the Earth in just few minutes and give them other fantastic possibilities. It's said in this timeframe 00:39 to 1:05.    

He spoke about Soviet/Russian development of a plasma-based anti-missile weapon by the Radio Instrument Building Research Institute (under Academician A. Avramenko)    

The system supposedly creates plasmoids (using ground-based microwave or laser generators) to ionize air along a warhead's path → disrupts aerodynamics → destroys the target via overloads at the speed of light.
